question.first_stage: population_overnight_20260910: 273 cases, seeds 0-14 of every configuration
question.reference: all reference seeds of the two configurations (50 logistic, 30 Rosenbrock); seeds 15-29 give paired comparisons
question.question: Do the seeds 0-14 shifts (larger noisy Rosenbrock SD3 posterior errors; two lost usable noisy logistic SD3 runs) replicate on the independent seeds 15-29 of the same frozen treatment?
question.confirmatory_family: Seeds 15-29 paired by seed with the reference: exact two-sided signed-rank tests of elbo_err, gskl and mmtv and exact McNemar tests of usability for each of the two configurations; eight tests under one Holm correction at alpha 0.05, fixed before the run. Primary outcomes: rosenbrock_D2_noise3 gskl and mmtv.
question.reporting: Report seeds 15-29 separately, then cumulative summaries of seeds 0-29 pooled with the first-stage campaign; recompute the 19-configuration KS screen and the paired family on the pooled population.
